text: browser_prepare refused: Chrome brings itself to the front to show its "Allow remote debugging?" prompt whenever a new DevTools connection opens (sessions then share that one connection), and turning remote debugging on needs Chrome in front, so attaching now would bring the browser in front of the app the user is working in. Nothing was changed, and browser_prepare is optional: use get_window_state on the browser window and act through its accessibility tree (set_value, click by element token), which needs no attachment. If the first read shows only browser chrome, read the window again. A browser window on another Space than the user's also attaches in the background. Retry with delivery_mode:"foreground" only when nobody is using this screen or the user agreed to the browser coming forward; the driver then brings the user's app back.
